subject: Activation constraints, roadmap asks, and doc dependency triage
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, partner-int@cloudvendor.com, Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-dev.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation constraints + milestone asks (initial list)

Team —

Quick heads-up as we finalize the July activation window for the new routing/quantization flow. Acme has signaled they want the shorter-latency variant in the first cohort, but they also flagged two blocking items:

- a doc describing the per-tenant KV cache behavior (security + retention questions)
- clarity on rollout order when Dedicated capacity is constrained (what we do if GPU pool A is short)

I've attached a short spreadsheet with constraints I've captured from the sales thread (activation_constraints.xlsx). Can product/ops confirm: is the July 15 ship a hard date from a roadmap perspective, or can we slide to July 29 if we need extra validation?

Also: who owns the enablement playbook? We need a single owner to publish the first draft so Solutions can start training.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation_constraints.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24 KB)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-dev.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation constraints + milestone asks (initial list)

Aditya —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. Short answers up front:

- Roadmap timing: July 15 is our product-targeted launch date but not an immovable deadline. We have two permissible slips (one week each) without triggering customer-level credits. Any further slides require leadership approval.

- KV cache doc: I started a draft of "KV cache behavior and retention" in Confluence (link below). It needs owner-level tech review (APIs + security notes). I can pull engineering reviewers but need an owner for overall content and a deadline.

- Rollout order under capacity shortfall: current policy is regional-first, then tier (enterprise before standard). We can make an explicit exception lane for strategic early customers (e.g., Acme) but that requires an ops-runbook update and an approved exception ticket.

Action requests:
1) Aditya — confirm the final list of strategic customers who should be on the exception lane by EOD Thu.
2) Marissa — can you scope the ops-runbook change (how long to enact, rollback triggers) by Friday?
3) Vivek — need a quick yes/no on leadership-level approval to consume one week's slip if QA reports regressions.

I've created the Drive folder for enablement artifacts and dropped a skeleton of the enablement playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-Launch-Readiness-Matrix

On doc ownership: I'm happy to act as editor and curator for the playbook, but I need a tech owner for the KV cache section.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Enablement Programs
Redwood Inference

Quoted: 
> On Tue, 22 Jun 2027, Aditya Rao wrote:
> > Team —
> > Quick heads-up as we finalize the July activation window for the new routing/quantization flow...

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation constraints + milestone asks (initial list)

Soojin/Aditya —

I scoped the ops-runbook change this morning. High-level notes:

- Work required: update routing policy doc, add an "exception lane" play that lists pre-reqs (security review, signed SLA addendum, agreed traffic cap).
- Estimated effort: 2 engineer-days + 1 SRE-day to validate on staging (assuming no infra changes).
- Rollback triggers: token error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5 minutes OR latency p50 > 300ms for 10 minutes.
- Time to turn it on: ~48 hours after approval for a staged roll (can be toggled by runbook flag).

Two items to flag as blockers:
1) Partner dependency: CloudVendor needs to push a new image for dedicated GPUs in region us-west-2. They've given an ETA of June 30; if that slips, we cannot guarantee Dedicated capacity for cohort 1. (I've looped partner-int@cloudvendor.com in the thread earlier.)
2) Docs gap: The KV cache doc needs a security appendix that explicitly calls out deletion/retention semantics and KMS integration notes. Until that's in the doc, InfoSec will not sign off.

I'll attach a short runbook patch (enablement_playbook_v1.md) with the play skeleton.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Launch Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: enablement_playbook_v1.md (markdown, 18 KB)

Also: prioritize the KV cache security appendix; InfoSec must sign before we flip the exception lane for strategic customers.

Vivek

All —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Consolidating next steps and owners so we have a single tracker: 

1) Finalize strategic customers list for exception lane — owner: Aditya — due: Thu 2027-06-24 EOD.
2) KV cache doc: tech owner needed + security appendix — owner: Aditya to propose tech owner; InfoSec review by Fri 2027-06-25. Link: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PL/KV+Cache+Behavior
3) Ops-runbook change (exception lane play) — owner: Marissa — patch complete by Fri 2027-06-25.
4) Partner capacity confirmation (CloudVendor image + Dedicated pool availability) — owner: Partner (partner-int@cloudvendor.com) — ETA: 2027-06-30.
5) Enablement playbook first draft (customer-facing training + cheat sheets) — owner: Soojin (editor/curator) — draft by Mon 2027-06-28.
6) Leadership approval window: Vivek approved one discretionary 1-week slide if needed. Any further slip requires finance sign-off.

Please reply in-thread with a single-line ack and any adjustments.

Soojin Lee
Head of Enablement Programs
Redwood Inference
